note: Trace form (research/trace-harness.md) for L03's Prisma 7.10.1 twins, with @prisma/adapter-pg: run as they are against PostgreSQL, their tables made from each twin's prisma/schema.prisma by prisma migrate diff (the clean twin's @@index lines become its indexes), the data from seed.sql at 1x and 10x, plans logged by auto_explain. A request reads a table without an index when its plan has a Seq Scan with a filter on a table of 10,000 rows or more that keeps under 5% of the rows it reads, at both scales. L03-p3 (OrderItem.orderId, which include: { items } reads by) is a finding on the schema with no endpoint, so its trace, at GET /orders/:id, is not linked. The app does not export itself, so each request names its route. Decoys, in both twins: findUnique by id, findFirst by an @unique field, a filter whose first field is indexed, filters on an enum and a Boolean that keep about half the rows, and a model named under smallTables.
